crossrefs.text: After all that has come upon us because of our evil deeds and our great guilt (though You, our God, have punished us less than our iniquities deserve and have given us such a remnant as this),
though You know that I am not guilty, and there is no deliverance from Your hand?
Because of the loving devotion of the LORD we are not consumed, for His mercies never fail.
The secret things belong to the LORD our God, but the things revealed belong to us and to our children forever, so that we may follow all the words of this law.

Now when Jobʼs three friends—Eliphaz the Temanite, Bildad the Shuhite, and Zophar the Naamathite—heard about all this adversity that had come upon him, each of them came from his home, and they met together to go and sympathize with Job and comfort him.
It still brings me comfort, and joy through unrelenting pain, that I have not denied the words of the Holy One.
Reconsider; do not be unjust. Reconsider, for my righteousness is at stake. Is there iniquity on my tongue? Can my mouth not discern malice?
If I have sinned, what have I done to You, O watcher of mankind? Why have You made me Your target, so that I am a burden to You?
But You have regarded trouble and grief; You see to repay it by Your hand. The victim entrusts himself to You; You are the helper of the fatherless.
Nothing in all creation is hidden from Godʼs sight; everything is uncovered and exposed before the eyes of Him to whom we must give account.
Then I will strike her children dead, and all the churches will know that I am the One who searches minds and hearts, and I will repay each of you according to your deeds.
He has made everything beautiful in its time. He has also set eternity in the hearts of men, yet they cannot fathom the work that God has done from beginning to end.
O, the depth of the riches of the wisdom and knowledge of God! How unsearchable are His judgments, and untraceable His ways!
Is not God as high as the heavens? Look at the highest stars, how lofty they are!
How could one man pursue a thousand, or two put ten thousand to flight, unless their Rock had sold them, unless the LORD had given them up?
But will God indeed dwell with man upon the earth? The heavens, even the highest heavens, cannot contain You, much less this temple I have built.
When you lie down, you will not be afraid; when you rest, your sleep will be sweet.
for the LORD will be your confidence and will keep your foot from the snare.
I lie down and sleep; I wake again, for the LORD sustains me.
I will lie down and sleep in peace, for You alone, O LORD, make me dwell in safety.
He will bring forth your righteousness like the dawn, your justice like the noonday sun.
My eyes grow dim with grief. I call to You daily, O LORD; I spread out my hands to You.
I stretch out my hands to You; my soul thirsts for You like a parched land. Selah
Then your light will break forth like the dawn, and your healing will come quickly. Your righteousness will go before you, and the glory of the LORD will be your rear guard.
